full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When a developer selects a recovery companion with a Core2 base source
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the language SHALL retain the existing base profile/wire and expose the separately versioned companion semantics, handler arenas and complete pair
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Paired source files and unchanged base Program/Continuation roots

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When paired source inspection succeeds
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: public inspect SHALL expose the complete base Program/filled plan, every companion site/handler/capture/statement/arena and full successful-path metadata
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Compare full program.inspect documentary object then independent freeze

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When a normal paired operation returns a checkpoint
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the checkpoint SHALL retain the exact complete versioned root/normal control/accounting/history fields in CONTRACT.json for pending, forward-complete or recovery-complete state
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Compare entire pending and both closed DTO variants

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When the paired start reaches an await or normal forward completion
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the returned record SHALL contain the actual base start outcome and actual complete boundary/captures/work/effects rather than an expected or host-reconstructed state
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Actual public start and actual saved checkpoint equal whole independent expectation

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When a new public process reopens an actual supported pending or closed checkpoint with its retained source pair
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: reopen SHALL expose the entire actual state/control/history/effects/C/T without an event, language execution or replacement scenario; its report SHALL distinguish this from a new invocation
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Fresh actual process reads actual saved file and preserves complete record

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When an admitted ordinary base event resumes the actual paired pending record
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the new record SHALL retain the full actual base report and history, carry the next actual pending frame or forward-complete state, and preserve all prior work/effects/duties
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Compare true and false normal resume before both terminal paths

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When an admitted recovery handler executes at its actual pending source site
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the handler SHALL use the actual captured pending environment and explicit typed event values, preserving base ExprIds and separate complete guard/body observations
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Whole source/arena/capture/raw Step/frame comparison

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When the admitted controlled-refund example successfully executes its source handler
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: its returned record SHALL append transfer60 and explicit duty discharge60, retain prior fee4/gross debit64/unrelated audit4 and retire only the selected forward pending path
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Complete custody-refund source/trace/financial/report/file comparison

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When the admitted forward-compensation example successfully executes its source handler
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: its returned record SHALL append reserve payment12 and explicit remedy discharge12 while retaining supplier payment40, fee3, residual remedy8 and unrelated audit4
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Complete compensation source/trace/financial/report/file comparison

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When a normal forward or recovery path closes with residual duties
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the full boundary SHALL retain zero rows and positive remaining liabilities, residual SHALL list every positive duty, and control closure SHALL not claim whole financial settlement or erase duties
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Compare complete boundaries plus residual rows and closed control

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When normal invocations and non-taken observations cross file/process boundaries
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: C/T/history/effects SHALL follow the exact ordinary equations in CONTRACT.json; false observations SHALL retain attempted work without adding it to committed successful-prefix work
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Direct C13/T13 vs false then C13/T15; normal compensation forward C11/T11 or T13

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When the paired plan exposes permitted successful forward and recovery paths
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: it SHALL expose each arm cost and paired successful_path_ceiling, retaining the normal forward total as a distinct field
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Compensation plan forward11 and paired ceiling13 remain distinct

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When a normal paired state-changing public command reports successful persisted output
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the real writer SHALL have published the complete actual resulting checkpoint and the complete report SHALL describe that same record
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Read actual published bytes; compare entire parsed record to report.checkpoint and next fresh read

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When a normal paired report is printed
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: it SHALL retain the exact report fields/local unsigned untracked qualifications and complete invocation/checkpoint, with actual process bytes separately compared to independently frozen bytes
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Whole semantic and separate public stdout/exit/stderr comparisons

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When public mori test runs a recovery manifest
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the actual same public executable SHALL run each fixed operation in a fresh process, pass actual files between operations, and retain full ordered actual reports/files/process results/comparisons
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Twelve isolated proposed case journeys across two source pairs; whole aggregates retained

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: Before an implementation/result comparison is scored
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: a distinct custodian SHALL freeze complete source/IR/trace/financial/work/byte expectations from adopted premises with dependencies/source exposure recorded
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Independent freeze predates actual comparison; no evaluator-generated golden

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When any local normal capability is reported
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the report SHALL retain every original MPLR/UNI/financial/composition/native/target/private/live-consumption/release obligation and distinguish implementation/evidence/acceptance
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: All original inventories/scenarios/parent exits retained without new completion percentage

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: Before complete first-delivery implementation or acceptance is claimed
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the exact designated-owner admission, failure-prefix, unknown/partial, identity, ceiling and IO/public result contracts SHALL be supplied and the applicable complete failure families retained
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Owner-authored exact contracts/tests/reviews and later authorized actual evidence; no ordinary substitute

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When source/history/trace/files/processes are admitted under a bounded claim
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the actual owner-selected existing resource envelope SHALL cover the whole paired domain and complete output without prefix or failure truncation
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Exact bounded source/trace/history/output resource observations remain separately required

full_lifecycle_EARS.when: When the new companion record is selected or evolved
full_lifecycle_EARS.shall: the public source/profile/record distinction SHALL stay explicit, and no bare old token SHALL be silently promoted to known missing history or terminal recovery state
full_lifecycle_EARS.ordinary_positive_predicate: Old no-companion fixtures retain exact current format; new pair selects complete new record

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Exact canonical preimages/domains/serialization and concrete identities for base Program/plan plus companion module/plan; source/version change and migration rules; old M03 compatibility and exact diagnostics.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of exact canonical preimages, domain separation, serialization, and concrete digests for all four bindings (base_program, base_plan, recovery_module, recovery_plan), compatibility with adopted M03 Core2 local digests (B32 F4), and version/migration refusal diagnostics.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Exact complete base+handler duty registry and permitted incoming/created/discharged identities, conflict/domain treatment and checking order.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of the combined base-program plus companion-handler liability registry, permitted incoming/created/discharged duty identities across forward and recovery branches, conflict detection, and checking order.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Exact source/branch account-row coverage, canonical boundary and preserved rows across forward/recovery; authentic custody/funding/control assumptions and missing/extra row policy.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of combined account-row coverage and canonical boundary validation across base actions and recovery handlers (including accounts like reserve in forward-compensation touched by handler transfers/fees or liability roles), preserved untouched rows, and custody vs. funded-compensation assumptions.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Concrete pair/handler/source/JSON/history/trace bounds and resource envelope; complete normal/recovery trace cells including preserved rows; no hidden subset, truncation or budget increase.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of concrete source-pair, handler-arena, JSON depth/node/byte, cumulative history, and trace-cell bounds covering full paired execution and test aggregates without silent prefix or history truncation.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Required successful_path_ceiling preflight with forward11/recovery13 discriminator; cap storage/override/editability/reserves, refusal order, cumulative attempt/committed overflow and all resource-cost distinctions.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of paired successful_path_ceiling preflight (distinguishing normal forward_total=11 from paired ceiling=13), committed_cap vs. cumulative attempted_total (T=15 after false observation) budget admission, CLI cap override/editability rules, recovery reserves, and refusal precedence.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Actual source/action/site/capture/history association, permitted changes and exact pending/closed transition admission; no unrelated source action or host replacement retires a pending path.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of strict pending site/action/capture/history association and transition admission ensuring only an admitted forward resume or site-bound recovery handler can retire the selected pending path, and closed records cannot be resumed or recovered.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Actual origin/correlation/finality/freshness/expiry and known/unknown rules; late success versus refund/compensation interpretation and signed temporal domains. Local Bool is not external evidence.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of outcome evidence origin, correlation, finality, freshness, expiry, known vs. unknown outcome classification, and late-success vs. recovery rules so local Bool binders are never treated as authenticated external nonexecution or timeout proof.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Per-stage recovery/normal/creation/discharge authority, exact assets/intent, consent/funding and retained gross/net/fee/duty constraints; custody refund versus funded forward compensation prerequisites.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of per-stage normal, refund, compensation, duty-creation, and duty-discharge authority/consent, asset custody vs. external reserve funding prerequisites, and preservation of historical gross debits, retained fees, and residual duties.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Actual strict record decoding/canonicality and source-bound import/provenance/history/accounting/control consistency; pending and both closed variants; migration, malformed/oversized/stale/tampered behavior and diagnostics.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of strict RecoveryCheckpoint decoding, canonicality, source-bound provenance, history/accounting/control consistency across pending, forward-complete, and recovery-complete variants (including dedicated history Step decoding without breaking shared Core1 v1 Statement deserialization), and malformed/oversized/stale/tampered refusal diagnostics.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Normal/recovery copies, replay, authority/nonce consumption, unique entitlement, races, revocation and target live-consumption policy; no local closed file proves global cancellation.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of once-only consumption, replay/copy prevention, concurrent normal-vs-recovery race resolution, authority/nonce consumption, and target live-consumption rules beyond untracked local checkpoint files.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Exact reachable prefixes and known retained state/effects/fees/duties/work/authority for each load/import/admission/guard/body/target phase failure; pending/closed/unresolved disposition, retries and full result/error DTO/code/offset/step/precedence. Include L04 conditional transfer-only-before-discharge family without assuming its reachability/commit policy.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of the complete failure family across load, import, admission, guard, body, and target phases—including exact reachable prefixes, retained state/effects/fees/duties/work, L04 conditional transfer-only-before-discharge disposition, and non-normal result/control/error DTOs without coercing failures into normal variants.

owner_prerequisites.proposal_exact_missing_contract: Writer publication/overwrite/path/crash/durability/read/write/export/stdout/child-process failure rules and ordering relative to actual local/target transition; exact published/known/unknown state notification and complete failure records. No copied proof writer or generic io::Error silently selects this.
owner_prerequisites.review_exact_dependency: Requires designated-owner specification of public checkpoint file publication/staging/overwrite/crash ordering relative to transition execution and stdout reporting, bounded reader/exporter limits, and child-process failure handling in mori simulate and mori test.

review_retained_scope_exact.explanation: The full original recovery first-delivery scope is retained without reduction: inspectable paired base (moriarty/2) and companion (moriarty-recovery/1) sources; actual versioned durable RecoveryCheckpoint carrier across pending, forward-complete, and recovery-complete states; real language start, normal resume, refund/compensate recovery, checkpoint publication, OS-process exit, fresh-process event-free reopen, and fresh-process mori test execution; complete ordered effects, retained fees, gross debits, C/T work counters, full invocation history, and positive residual duties; all 35 original MPLR requirements, 148 requirements / 292 scenarios / 20 UTXO families, 69 top-level U/M/MC/SP/G exits, ACTUS 277, DeFi 72, and all 5 composition operators. No waiting JSON viewer, bare Continuation, in-memory-only Process, test-only writer, or host copy/sum substitution is permitted. All 12 designated-owner rules (O-ID through O-IO) remain mandatory open prerequisites, and no example/oracle arithmetic or byte certification is claimed.

scope_qualification: Retention is contractual scope, not fulfillment: all14 staged gaps;148requirements/292scenarios/20families;119UTXO/11first-contract/18PCD inventories;69U/M/MC/SP/G exits;ACTUS277;DeFi72;five composition operators;all proof/target/ledger/private/live-consumption and release obligations remain. B does not separately enumerate every14gap ID; their complete adopted scope source remains in B32/B34 and no closure is claimed. All20 DR rows remain proposed-only/acceptance_closed:false. This lane makes no new owner policy or adoption judgment.
